title: Surreal Mechanical Collage
description: A split composition featuring a large mechanical eye with green concentric lenses and metallic spikes in the upper half, alongside a pink-haired woman with bare shoulders and a dripping pink heart with orange splatter on the left. The lower half shows a stylized running brown deer, a cartoon rabbit in a black suit, a coiled rope, and abstract blue and beige shapes.
